mission.title: The AI Aerodynamicist: lower drag at 70 m/s
mission.statement: Find a lower-drag aerodynamic design at 70 m/s. Preserve the required downforce, stay within the geometry constraints, and validate the final design using CFD.

constraints.name: balance_front
constraints.label: aero balance (front share)
constraints.text: aero balance (front share) >= 0.9 x baseline and <= 1.1 x baseline

conditions.ground: moving road at the flow speed
conditions.turbulence: steady RANS k-omega SST, wall functions

hypotheses: the rear flap is the largest single source of drag that can be traded for downforce elsewhere
a steeper diffuser adds underfloor downforce at little drag until the flow separates from the ramp
a lower floor strengthens the ground effect (more downforce) within the clearance limit
front-wing angle moves the aero balance forward; rear-wing angle moves it back
